plan_review.notes: Reviewer found that merge-train-noop had no phase mapping, which would render an empty phase list. Added an explicit merge-train cleanup phase and regression coverage; no alternate architecture was needed.

independent_grade.notes: The change correctly and safely streamlines the CI recovery comment logic. It sorts blockers according to a well-defined phase array, gracefully handling the dual nature of review-thread blockers (which need both feedback and resolution phases). The exclusion of aggregate CI failures when concrete ones exist is accurately implemented and covered by new tests.
